title: The ring, Thursday
logline: Thursday. Julian, on the phone, drawn as the gray coat on the hook — in Gully's now, on the bait hook. Chloe takes the call on the dock. Wood letters the 2013 flyer's date wrong and fixes it.

panels.composition: Gully's. CHLOE's phone ringing. On the wall by the door, the strip draws a gray coat on a bait hook — Julian, as always. Chloe going out to the dock with the phone.
props: a gray coat on a bait hook

image.prompt: razor-sharp brush and ink, a woman going out a shack door to a dock with a ringing phone while a gray coat hangs on a bait hook by the door, a man in an apron and a thin man on a stool inside
image.notes: Julian: the gray coat, on a bait hook this time.

panels.composition: Through the window: Chloe on the dock, phone to her ear, left hand up at her face — the dot near her eye. Her mouth: something kind.

characters.pose: on the dock, on the phone

image.prompt: razor-sharp brush and ink, seen through a shack window, a woman on a dock with a phone at her ear and her left hand raised near her face, speaking kindly

panels.composition: WOOD, inside, lettering a flyer — an old habit, a February flyer in March — and writing the wrong year. 2003. Crossing it out. 2013.

image.prompt: razor-sharp brush and ink, a thin man lettering a flyer and striking out a wrong year to write the right one
image.notes: Letter after: 2003 struck through, 2013. Ten years since the opening, since the dock strip of Dec 2002.

panels.composition: Gully, watching the dock, watching Wood.

balloons.text: Somebody should say something this week.

image.prompt: razor-sharp brush and ink, a stocky man in an apron speaking quietly to a thin man who is fixing a flyer, a woman visible on the dock beyond the window

art.line: razor-sharp, confident brush and ink; pristine perspective; crisp silhouettes; zero crosshatch in close-ups
art.palette: dailies: black ink, one spot tone at most. Sundays: wet-on-wet — gray-green moss, fog, rusted tin, bruised dusk
art.paper: bristol for dailies; 140 lb Arches cold-press for Sundays

notes: Julian on the bait hook. 2003 struck to 2013. 'Somebody should say something this week.'
